description: Foundational engineering culture rules enforced on code generated by developers and AI agents.

rules.name: Zero Lazy Code & Complete Implementation
rules.description: Prohibits incomplete code generated by AI agents, including TODOs, FIXMEs, or empty stubs.
rules.rationale: Code must be delivered fully functional without hidden operational gaps.
rules.remediation: Implement the complete logic or formally document the scope division.

rules.name: Spec Traceability Obligation
rules.description: Requires an annotation linking the artifact to the specification requirement (@spec RFxx).
rules.rationale: Guarantees bidirectional traceability between specs and source code.
rules.remediation: Add an annotation @spec RF<number> referencing the requirement.

rules.name: Mandatory Automated Test Coverage
rules.description: Requires every production module to have a corresponding test file.
rules.rationale: No code is merged into production without automated validation.
rules.remediation: Create the corresponding test file covering happy and error paths.

rules.name: Zero Hardcoded Secrets and Tokens
rules.description: Prohibits plaintext credentials, API tokens, or secrets hardcoded in source code.
rules.rationale: Protects infrastructure and data against credential leaks.
rules.remediation: Use environment variables or secrets management vaults.

rules.name: Strict Typing & Contract Clarity
rules.description: Requires explicit type annotations for parameters and return types.
rules.rationale: Prevents ambiguity and runtime type hallucinations.
rules.remediation: Declare explicit types on all public functions and methods.
